`global_classical_solution`: for every admissible datum (f₀ ≥ 0 smooth compactly supported in ℝ³×ℝ³; E₀, B₀ C^∞ with bounded derivatives of all orders, in L², div E₀ = ρ[f₀], div B₀ = 0) there is a solution of the full relativistic system (v̂ = v/√(1+|v|²), force E + v̂×B, ∂ₜE - curl B = -j, ∂ₜB + curl E = 0, Gauss laws) that is C^∞ on every [0,T], and every C¹ solution in the class (nonnegative, L²-continuous fields, compact phase support on finite horizons) coincides with it for t ≥ 0; no smallness, symmetry or neutrality assumption.
